Properties.Global: ; Nil is default sov ; ; otherwise spawns as the sovereign type set here ()

; Only applies to ships ; ; Modes are: ; - orbit: orbits an anchor ; - defend: defends an anchor ; - hunt: cheat-searches for enemies in the system, once all enemies are dead, sits around and waits for more enemies ; - patrol: flies between gates in this system, if multiple gates are available. Otherwise leaves. "orbit"

; Spawn location ; ; Modes are: ; - player: spawns at the player ; - target: spawns at the current target of the player (otherwise spawns at player) ; - random: spawns in a random location in the system "player"

Properties.DynamicData: ; Get nearest active enemy that isnt the player ; The player very likely set invulnerability if they are ; doing something that involves spawning in ships ; We can use a different option for handling attacking the player (sysFindObject gSource "sTAENZ")

Properties.Data: ; Max distance from a higher priority object that we will search ; for lower or equal priority objects to patrol from 200

; ratio by which we decrease the max cluster distance for lower ; priority objects we treat as being in one cluster ; eg: ; maxClusterDistance = 200 ; maxClusterDistRatio = 0.5 ; maxClusterDistanceP1 = 100 ; maxClusterDistanceP2 = 50 ; maxClusterDistanceP3 = 25 0.5

; At and above this priority level, we treat these objects as ; hubs and will return to them after patrolling each lower-priority sub-cluster ; Lower-priority clusters are patrolled in a round-robin manner 1
; If non-nil, shuffle the order of objects 1
; If non-nil, we skip any patrol targets with a parent and no children 1
; Max distance we will scan for hostiles from our patrol route 60
; Rate at which we scan for hostiles (in ticks) 60
; If we are below this health fraction we flee to a friendly station to repair if one exists 0.2
; If non-nil, we ignore player aggression 1

(= state "attacking") (if (gr (sysVectorDistance (objGetPos gSource) (objGetPos (objGetTarget gSource))) (* scanRange 1.5) ) ; Break off our attack if it got away ; we let onOrdersCompleted run to resume course (shpCancelOrders gSource) )

() ) )

Events.OnAttacked:
(block ( (state (obj@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrolState")) (ignorePlayer (obj@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrol.ignorePlayer")) (wasTargeted (= gSource (objGetTarget aOrderGiver))) ) (switch ; Keep fleeing if already fleeing (or (= state "flee") (= state "fleeGate")) ()
; If our health is too low we flee (ls (obj@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrol.health") (obj@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrol.minHealth")) (block ( (safeHarbor (srvFindRepairArmor gSource 60 (itmGetLevel (shpGetArmor gSource 0)))) ) (if safeHarbor ; Find a safe location to repair (block () (objSet@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrolState" "flee") (shpCancelOrders gSource) (shpOrder gSource 'dock safeHarbor) (shpOrder gSource 'wait (random 3 8)) ) ; Otherwise flee for a gate if one exists (block () (objSet@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrolState" "fleeGate") (shpCancelOrders gSource) (shpOrder gSource 'gate) ) ) )
; If we are configured to ignore the player we do so (and ignorePlayer (= aOrderGiver gPlayerShip)) ()
; If we are fighting already then keep fighting (or (= state "retaliating") (= state "attacking")) ()
; If no one is reponsible, then nothing to do
(not (objCanAttack aOrderGiver)) ()

wasTargeted (block () (objSet@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrolState" "retaliating") (shpCancelOrders gSource) (shpOrder gSource 'attack aOrderGiver) )
; If this is a friend, then ignore since it was just friendly fire probably
(= (objGetDisposition gSource aOrderGiver) 'friend) ()
; Otherwise we retaliate
(block () (objSet@ gSource "adt.objCreate.patrolState" "retaliating") (shpCancelOrders gSource) (shpOrder gSource 'attack aOrderGiver) ) ) )

;; List of all create objects settings menu options (can be extended by other mods) (setq ADT_uiCreateObjectSettingsMenuOptions (list { text: ADT_objCreateObjectModeMenuText action: ADT_objCreateObjectModeMenuOpen isDS: True } { text: ADT_objCreateObjectPosMenuText action: ADT_objCreateObjectPosMenuOpen isDS: True } { text: ADT_objCreateObjectSovMenuText action: ADT_objCreateObjectSovMenuOpen isDS: True } ))
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;; ;; Create object functions ;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;; Sort Creatable Types (setq ADT_sortKeyObjectTypes (lambda (typ) (cat "VIRTUAL:" (typMatches theType "V") "TYPE_PRIORITY:" (hex (ADT_typCategoryPriority obj) 8) "\nSOVEREIGN:" (typGetName (or (typ@ theType 'defaultSovereign) (typ@ theType 'sovereign))) "\nSOVEREIGN_UNID:" (fmtUNID (or (typ@ theType 'defaultSovereign) (typ@ theType 'sovereign))) "\nNAME:" (typGetName typ) "\nUNID:" (fmtUNID typ) ) ))
;; Type Priority Sort subkey (setq ADT_typCategoryPriority (lambda (typ) (block ( (m (lambda (criteria) (typMatches typ criteria))) (defaultSov (or (typ@ theType 'defaultSovereign) (typ@ theType 'sovereign))) (isPlayer (= defaultSov &svPlayer;)) (isFriend (= (sovGetDisposition defaultSov &svPlayer;) 'friend)) (isNeutral (= (sovGetDisposition defaultSov &svPlayer;) 'neutral)) (isEnemy (= (sovGetDisposition defaultSov &svPlayer;) 'enemy)) (isStation (m "T")) (isShip (m "s")) (isWorld (m "t")) (isVirtual (m "V")) (isUntyped (=== (objGetType obj))) ) (switch isUntyped 0xFFFFFFFF (and isShip isVirtual) 0xFFFFFFFE (and isStation isVirtual) 0xFFFFFFFD (and isStation isPlayer) 0x20 (and isStation isFriend) 0x21 (and isStation isNeutral) 0x22 (and isStation isEnemy) 0x23 isStation 0x24 (and isShip isPlayer) 0x40 (and isShip isFriend) 0x41 (and isShip isNeutral) 0x42 (and isShip isEnemy) 0x43 isShip 0x44 isWorld 0x50 ;; other 0x80000000 ) ) ))
;; Open obj create selection menu (setq ADT_objCreateObjectSelectMenuOpen (lambda () (scrShowScreen gScreen &ADT_dsCreateObject;)))
;; Open obj create options menu (setq ADT_objCreateObjectOptionsMenuOpen (lambda () (scrShowScreen gScreen &ADT_dsCreateObjectOptions;)))
;; List of all create objects options menu options (can be extended by other mods) (setq ADT_uiCreateObjectMainMenuOptions (list { text: "Create objects" action: ADT_objCreateObjectSelectMenuOpen isDS: True } { text: "Create objects settings" action: ADT_objCreateObjectOptionsMenuOpen isDS: True } ))
;; Open obj create menu (setq ADT_objCreateMainMenuOpen (lambda () (scrShowScreen gScreen &ADT_dsCreateObjectMain;)))
)
